page.notes: The right part of the page is cut off, so entries on the right side and the rest of the page are missing. Some entries are faint or smudged, especially "Minyas" and "mori, in elementa"; the first line "s wrbs." is uncertain ("s" may be a stray mark, possibly "urbs"). Page furniture of the running head is reconstructed as "I N D", partly cut. Lines with heavy stains: "mori, nihil habere", "monstrofae". The scan is cut off at the top and bottom; the first entry is a fragment. Several entries are doubtful in the scan (e.g. "Muabus fl.", "mortis contemptu"). Marked ornaments and stains omitted.
